label: Power needed for flight grows as length^3.5 while muscle power grows as length^3
statement_en: A bird of fixed proportions must fly at a minimum speed proportional to the square root of its linear size, so the work needed for flight varies as the 3½ power of linear size while the work its muscles can supply varies only as the cube; flight thus becomes harder as birds get larger (about 1.4 times harder per doubling of length).

scope.basis: a theorem about a model: it applies wherever the design supplies the quantities it uses and accepts the hypotheses in scope.assumed
kernelChecked: Exact: lift = ½ ρ v² S C_L equal to weight with 0 < C_L ≤ C_L,max implies v ≥ sqrt(2W/(ρ S C_L,max)) (vmin_le).
Under R1, R2, constant ρ and C_L,max: v_min(L2)/v_min(L1) = sqrt(L2/L1), log exponent 1/2 (vmin_ratio, vmin_log).
With constant L/D, power required at v_min: ratio (L2/L1)^3 sqrt(L2/L1), log exponent 7/2 (powerRequired_ratio, powerRequired_log).
Under MusclePowerLaw (named hypothesis) and R1: power available ratio (L2/L1)^3 (powerAvailable_ratio); P_req/P_avail = c sqrt(L) with an explicit c (powerRatio_eq).
assumed: Constant C_L,max across sizes (Reynolds effects change it), constant ρ, constant L/D, and flight at v_min rather than a faster, more efficient speed.

The muscle premise of Thompson (muscle fraction f and mass-specific power p constant) is contested: contraction frequency falls with size, so the modern expectation is an exponent below 3. It is carried as a hypothesis, never proved or asserted.

The physics thread found one Cypselurus hiraii specimen inside its v_min envelope (v_min 9.85 m/s against field speeds 10-20 m/s) but could not test the sqrt(W/S) scaling with its data; the theorems are statements about the model, not confirmed facts.

lean.source:
/-- The `log` form of R5: exponent `7/2`. -/
theorem powerRequired_log {W S : ℝ → ℝ} {k₁ k₂ ρ Cmax LD : ℝ} (hW : CubeLaw W k₁) (hS : AreaLaw S k₂)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hCmax : 0 < Cmax) (hLD : 0 < LD) {L₁ L₂ : ℝ} (h₁ : 0 < L₁) (h₂ : 0 < L₂) :
    Real.log (powerRequired (W L₂) (vmin ρ Cmax (W L₂) (S L₂)) LD /
      powerRequired (W L₁) (vmin ρ Cmax (W L₁) (S L₁)) LD) = 7 / 2 * Real.log (L₂ / L₁) := by
  rw [powerRequired_ratio hW hS hρ hCmax hLD h₁ h₂]
  have hq : 0 < L₂ / L₁ := by positivity
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow, Real.log_sqrt hq.le]
  push_cast
  ring

named_hypotheses.name: Delphi.AreaLaw
named_hypotheses.source:
/-- Isometry of an area: `S L = k L²`. -/
def AreaLaw (S : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ) : Prop := 0 < k ∧ ∀ L, 0 < L → S L = k * L ^ 2

constraint_details.relation: v ≥ sqrt(2 W / (ρ S C_L,max)), checked as v^2 ≥ 2W/(ρ S C_L,max)
constraint_details.canEliminate: a design or claim of steady lift-supported flight below its own minimum speed
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C9, minimum speed.** Steady lift-supported flight at airspeed `v` with `v² < 2W/(ρ S C_L,max)` is ruled
out (`v < v_min`). -/
theorem vmin_rules_out {ρ S C Cmax W v : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hS : 0 < S) (hC : 0 < C) (hCmax : C ≤ Cmax)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hlift : lift ρ v S C = W) (h : v ^ 2 < 2 * W / (ρ * S * Cmax)) : False := by
  have h1 := vmin_le hρ hS hC hCmax hv hlift
  have h2 : v < vmin ρ Cmax W S := by
    unfold vmin
    exact (Real.lt_sqrt hv).mpr h
  linarith

constraint_details.relation: d log P_req / d log L = 7/2
constraint_details.canEliminate: a candidate asserting the full set of hypotheses with a power-required exponent other than 3.5 (note: power AVAILABLE is not constrained; its L^3 rests on the contested muscle premise)
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C10, power required.** Under R1, R2, constant `ρ`, `C_L,max` and `L/D`, flight at `v_min`: a committed
log-log exponent `b ≠ 7/2` of `P_req` on `L` is ruled out. -/
theorem powerRequired_exponent_rules_out {W S : ℝ → ℝ} {k₁ k₂ ρ Cmax LD : ℝ} (hW : CubeLaw W k₁)
    (hS : AreaLaw S k₂) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hCmax : 0 < Cmax) (hLD : 0 < LD) {L₁ L₂ b : ℝ} (h₁ : 0 < L₁) (h₂ : 0 < L₂)
    (hne : L₁ ≠ L₂)
    (hb : Real.log (powerRequired (W L₂) (vmin ρ Cmax (W L₂) (S L₂)) LD /
      powerRequired (W L₁) (vmin ρ Cmax (W L₁) (S L₁)) LD) = b * Real.log (L₂ / L₁)) (h : b ≠ 7 / 2) : False := by
  have hlog := powerRequired_log hW hS hρ hCmax hLD h₁ h₂
  rw [hb] at hlog
  have hq : 0 < L₂ / L₁ := by positivity
  have hq1 : L₂ / L₁ ≠ 1 := by
    intro h0
    exact hne ((div_eq_one_iff_eq h₁.ne').mp h0).symm
  have hl : Real.log (L₂ / L₁) ≠ 0 := Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one hq hq1
  exact h (mul_right_cancel₀ hl hlog)
